Issue 3531. Scroll to the metadata at the end of the DXIL output and look at the
!DIGlobalVariable and !DILocalVariable entries. Three appear: two for the file-scope
declarations, and one for the entry point's `val`. The resource declared *inside* the entry
point gets neither kind of entry, even though the CreateHandleFromHeap call built from it does
carry a !dbg location pointing back at its source line. Changing that declaration's type from
a resource to a plain uint makes a !DILocalVariable entry appear for it.

Compiler Explorer appends `-Zi -Qembed_debug -Fc -` to every DXC pane, so a pane always has
debug info switched on whether or not you asked for it. Here that matches on purpose: the
local runs behind this triage passed `-Zi -Qembed_debug` as well, so the panes test the same
configuration rather than one Compiler Explorer chose. This banner is compiled as part of the
source, so pane line numbers are offset from those in the local captures.
